ideas.pitch: An AI-powered geographic risk and logistics tracker for small manufacturing and retail businesses in Newark to optimize local supply chains.
ideas.title: Newark Local Business Supply Chain Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines spatial mapping with predictive analytics, echoing the technical depth of GeoNex-ATLAS which won by addressing localized industrial monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A localized multilingual patient intake and trust platform tailored for Newark community health centers to streamline acquisition and triage.
ideas.title: Community Health AI Intake & Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of Global-Smile, which won a 12-hour sprint by focusing narrowly on trust-building and patient acquisition for specific clinics.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform using satellite and environmental data to evaluate and score urban buildings for green infrastructure retrofits.
ideas.title: Newark Green Roof & Urban Heat Mitigation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architectures proven to win hackathons like GreenNovation by structuring complex environmental workflows into distinct agent roles.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent platform that ingests local grant requirements and automatically verifies expense compliance using secure ledger records.
ideas.title: Automated Micro-Grant Compliance Agent for Newark Nonprofits
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an autonomous agent marketplace workflow similar to the Synthesis Hackathon winner Dispatch, emphasizing automated utility and compliance.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and probabilistic forecasting tool designed to model local economic disruption incidents for municipal planners in New Jersey.
ideas.title: AI-Powered Regional Economic Risk Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals directly inspired by the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner.
